Deploy agents that learn, make decisions, and improve your digital experiences using Liferay AI Hub.
What Is a CMP?

A Content Marketing Platform (CMP) is a centralized software solution that streamlines the entire content marketing process, from planning and creation to multi-channel distribution. By offering full visibility across the content lifecycle, CMPs help ensure brand consistency, support data-driven decisions, and deliver relevant content to the right audience, ultimately driving engagement, lead nurturing, and revenue through high-quality storytelling.

value_i18n.en_US: Launch Secure and Efficient AI Agents
Set up powerful and integrated AI agents.

Deploy AI agents directly within the Liferay Platform to handle a wide range of tasks.

Design agent logic through a visual, low-code drag-and-drop interface accessible to both technical and business users, accelerate adoption with ready-to-use templates, and streamline creation using prebuilt nodes for LLMs, data, custom code, and API integrations.
Enable AI agents to jump into action when you need them.

Define flexible automation triggers to launch AI agents manually, on a schedule, via APIs, or in response to Liferay DXP events.

These agents can automate content operations, route support tickets intelligently, and dynamically segment users to enable faster workflows and more effective personalization.
Monitor the success of your AI Agents.

A centralized dashboard provides full visibility and control over AI agents by monitoring usage, performance, and costs.

It offers insights into active agents and automations, agent efficiency over time, and resource consumption, enabling smarter optimization and resource allocation decisions.
Implement AI with necessary enterprise-grade security and governance.

While AI is powerful, it can introduce cybersecurity risks if not properly managed.

Liferay DXP protects users and sensitive data by enforcing strict access policies and fine-grained permissions, ensuring AI systems access only the information authorized for each user. Learn more about Liferay’s security capabilities here.
Coming Soon
Connect to the compliant LLM of your choice.

Large language models (LLMs) power AI agents with advanced reasoning, planning, and decision-making.

Liferay DXP lets you connect and configure LLMs easily, using Model Context Protocols (MCPs) to securely provide the data they need. It supports popular MCPs from Microsoft and GitLab, and also offers Liferay’s own MCP to make the platform AI-ready.

<style>
  .dxp-gradient-text mark {
    color: #8881f9;
    background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #659aff, #7414ff80);
    background-clip: text;
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  }

.dxp-capabilities-description .highlight {
	color: #C379FB;
	font-weight: 700;
}
  
.ai-hub-sticky.stop-sticky {
	position: static !important;
	top: auto !important;
}

</style>
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
	const stickyElement = document.querySelector('.ai-hub-sticky');
	const lastSection = document.querySelector('#ai-hub-plans');
	const purchaseButton = document.querySelector(
		'a[href="#ai-hub-plans"]'
	);

	if (purchaseButton && lastSection) {
		purchaseButton.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
			event.preventDefault();

			window.scrollTo({
				top: lastSection.offsetTop,
				behavior: 'smooth',
			});
		});
	}

	if (stickyElement && lastSection) {
		const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
			([entry]) => {

				stickyElement.classList.toggle(
					'stop-sticky',
					entry.intersectionRatio >= 0.5
				);
			},
			{
				rootMargin: '0px 0px -200px 0px',
				threshold: 0.5,
			}
		);

		observer.observe(lastSection);
	}
});
</script>
